rss: Energy bills to rise by 26% from January after gas prices surge
title: Energy Prices Cause Big Changes
story: In BizKid world, the cost of energy is going up! This means it costs more to keep your house warm and your gadgets running.
storyBig: The increase in energy prices by 26% means families will have to spend more on their energy bills. This impacts how they budget for other fun things like toys and treats.
think: How can families save energy at home?
bull: Learning to save energy is good for the planet!
bear: Higher energy bills mean less money for other fun things.

rss: Why tiny cars are taking off across Europe
title: Mini Cars Are Zooming Ahead!
story: In BizKid world, tiny cars are becoming super popular! Kids and families like them because they are easy to park and use less energy.
storyBig: The popularity of tiny cars is increasing as they offer an efficient, eco-friendly alternative to traditional vehicles, making them appealing to young drivers.
think: Why might people choose tiny cars over big ones?
bull: Tiny cars are good for the environment!
bear: Tiny cars might not fit big families comfortably.
